About me

I'm Owoyemi Odunola M, a Junior UI/UX Designer and Website Designer based in Nigeria. I combine visual problem-solving with user-centered thinking to create digital experiences that are clear, engaging and easy to use.

Using Figma, I turn ideas and requirements into wireframes, polished UI designs and interactive prototypes. My work spans responsive websites, mobile interfaces, e-commerce flows and compelling visual communication for brands.

I approach each brief with care, balancing usability, visual hierarchy and business goals to deliver user-focused work for clients and collaborative teams.

A bold eye for design, backed by the basics.
